problems.statement: Find the degree of the splitting field over $\mathbb{Q}$ for $f(x) = x^{17} - 1$.
Let $K$ be a field of 8 elements. Compute the Galois group of the Galois cover of $K$ over the prime field of $K$.

**(a)** Compute the degree of the extension $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{5}, \sqrt{7})$ over $\mathbb{Q}$.

**(b)** Find an element $\theta \in K$ such that $K = \mathbb{Q}(\theta)$.

Let $f(x)$ be irreducible over $\mathbb{Q}$, and let $F$ be its splitting field over $\mathbb{Q}$. Show that if the Galois group of $F$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ is abelian, then $F = \mathbb{Q}(u)$ for all roots $u$ of $f(x)$.
